note: Interludes in number order (1, 2, 3), as most guides play them (Splitstone itself uses a speedrun order). Path of Exile 2 1.0 (11 December 2026) removes the interludes and adds the final acts: this route will be updated after its patch notes.

sources.name: Splitstone
sources.what: the campaign route, area ids, level targets and permanent rewards (patch 0.5.5, Forbidden Rites)

totals.note: from books and quests in Acts 1–4 and the interludes

steps.t: Kill The Bloated Miller, enter Clearfell Encampment
Talk to Renly → first Uncut Skill Gem, head out to Clearfell
Kill Beira of the Rotten Pack (+10% cold res), go to The Grelwood
steps.r: +10% Cold Resistance (Head of the Winter Wolf, Beira)

steps.t: Mysterious Campsite (checkpoint), guaranteed Uncut Skill Gem
Mud Burrow / The Devourer: only a Lv2 skill gem plus a support gem from Renly (unless you're doing the Ritual cluster)
steps.h: Side content most routes skip: small rewards.

steps.t: Grab the Tree of Souls waypoint and the Grim Tangle waypoint, then go up the river to The Red Vale
Witch Hut cauldron gives a Medium Life + Mana Flask even without the kill. Areagne, Forgotten Witch drops a Support Gem (respawn at checkpoint first)
Gerung, the Brambleghast: only a Lv2 skill gem (Ritual cluster 1 needs him)
steps.h: Side content most routes skip: small rewards.

steps.t: Activate 3 Obelisks of Rust, kill The Rust King, portal to town
Hand the runes to Renly → Runed Spikes, then WP to The Grelwood
Break the 3 Runic Seals at the Tree of Souls, portal to town, talk to Una there, then WP to The Grim Tangle
Summon Una at the roots, continue to Cemetery of the Eternals
Ervig, the Rotted Druid: guaranteed Support Gem
Activate waypoint + checkpoint, enter Tomb of the Consort
Ancient Ruin sarcophagus at the zone edge: guaranteed Iron or Lazuli Ring (transmute it)
Kill Asinia → Memorial Key Piece
Haunted Treasure POI spawns a rare with a guaranteed Support Gem
Kill Draven → Memorial Key Piece
Forgotten Riches POI: gold + rare chest with a Support Gem
Open the Memorial Gate by the WP, kill Lachlann of Endless Lament, go to Hunting Grounds
Kill The Crowbell (+2 passive points), activate Ogham Farmlands WP, go to Freythorn
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Crowbell)

steps.t: Cleanse 3 Ritual Altars, kill The King in the Mists (+30 Spirit)
steps.r: +30 Spirit (Gembloom Skull, King in the Mists)

steps.t: Finn: pick a Charm; Una: buy a Greater Life/Mana Flask, then WP to Ogham Farmlands
Pick up Una's Lute at Una's Hut, follow the road to Ogham Village
Crop Circle rare in the wheat field: guaranteed Lv4 Uncut Skill Gem (walk into the center)
Kill The Executioner, pull the lever, talk to Leitis. Get Smithing Tools from Renly's Workshop.
Hand Una's Lute to Una (+2 passive points), collect Leitis' Lv5 gem, give Smithing Tools + Blank Rune to Renly
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Una, The Lost Lute)

steps.t: Go to Ogham Manor, reaching level 13 on the way
Kill Candlemass (+20 life) on floor 1, kill Count Geonor at level 14
steps.r: +20 Maximum Life (Candlemass)

steps.t: Talk to the Hooded One → 'Follow the Beast's Trail' → Vastiri Outskirts
Kill Rathbreaker, portal back, take Zarka's Uncut Skill Gem, enter The Ardura Caravan
Raider Camp (checkpoint): tier-2 support gem
Talk to the Hooded One, then Asala → Desert Map → Mawdun Quarry
Find the entrance to Mawdun Mine
War Cache at the zone edge (checkpoint): guaranteed Artificer's Orb. Don't backtrack for it
Kill Rudja, the Dread Engineer, free Risu, portal to caravan
Talk to Risu, then Asala → Desert Map → Traitor's Passage
Run through to The Halani Gates
Bell chest (checkpoint): Uncut Skill Gem Lv6
Balbala (most speedrunners): a Lv28 Barya is available in Deshar for the late ascendancy
steps.h: Side content most routes skip: small rewards.

steps.t: Kill Jamanra, the Risen King (level 18+), take the stairs down, portal to caravan
Take Zarka's Lv7 Uncut Skill Gem, talk to Asala → Mastodon Badlands
Find the entrance to The Bone Pits
Shrine of Bones near checkpoint: Lv2 support gem
Kill Iktab & Ekbab → Mastodon Tusks; collect the Sun Clan Relic from hyenas
Kill Kabala, Constrictor Queen (+2 passive points); collect the Kabala Clan Relic from snakes
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Kabala)

steps.t: Abandoned Prayer (down the stairs): guaranteed magic amulet
Find the entrance to the Buried Shrines
Golden Tomb (Spirit Gem Lv7), Ninth Treasure of Keth scarab (Jewel)
Kill Azarian, the Forsaken Son, put the Water Goddess to rest → Essence of Water
Elemental Offering (checkpoint): resistance ring + matching rune. Pick your lowest resistance
Activate the 3 Ancient Seals; place both relics at the Relic Altar (+1 charm slot)
steps.r: +1 Charm Slot (Relic Altar); Charm bonus: 30% charm charges OR 30% charm duration (swappable)

steps.t: Kill Zalmarath, the Colossus → Flame Ruby; Zarka gives the Horn of the Vastiri
Titan's Sword POI: guaranteed Lesser Rune (only if on your path)
Desert Map to the sandstorm (Traitor's Passage), Sound the Horn at the front, Asala → Deshar
Take the Final Letter from Fallen Dekhara; kill the Watchful Twins vultures for the Lv28 Barya
Guaranteed Artificer's Orb right at the start along the left or right edge
Run through to The Spires of Deshar
Shifting Vases / Hushed Urn: 4 rares + Lv2 Support Gem
Click the Sisters of Garukhan (+10% lightning res), kill Tor Gul, the Defiler
steps.r: +10% Lightning Resistance (Sisters of Garukhan)

steps.t: Hand the Final Letter to Shambrin (+2 passive points); Zarka → Desert Map → Trial of the Sekhemas
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Shambrin, Tradition's Toll)

steps.t: 1st Ascendancy: run the trial with the Lv28 Barya from Deshar
steps.r: 1st Ascendancy: 2 Ascendancy Points

steps.t: Kill Jamanra, the Abomination (act boss)
Talk to the Hooded One in the shrine NW of the caravan's midpoint, then Asala → Sandswept Marsh
Run through to the Ziggurat Encampment
Orok Campfire basket near the exit: Lesser Jeweller's Orb
Talk to Oswald (opens his shop), check vendors, exit at the top of town to Jungle Ruins
Kill Mighty Silverfist (+2 passive points), follow snakes to the Venom Crypts
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Mighty Silverfist)

steps.t: Take the venom from the corpse; hand it to Servi for a PERMANENT choice + Artificer's Orb
steps.r: Servi's Venom Draught (PERMANENT): 25% Stun Threshold / 30% Elemental Ailment Threshold / 25% Mana Regen

steps.t: Run through to the Chimeral Wetlands
Grab the Temple of Chaos WP, kill Xyclucian → Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum, enter Jiquani's Machinarium
Ravaged Camp: guaranteed rare armour + Lost Temple Logbook
Use Small Soul Cores (altar + locked exit); kill Blackjaw → Flame Core (+10% fire res)
steps.r: +10% Fire Resistance (Flame Core, Blackjaw)

steps.t: Place 2 Medium Soul Cores in the generators, kill Zicoatl → Large Soul Core, WP to Jungle Ruins
Put the Large Soul Core into the Stone Altar → opens The Matlan Waterways
Walk over the pressure pads, activate the mechanism at the end
Narag's Hut rare drops a rare weapon
Kill Ignagduk, the Bog Witch → Gemrot Skull (+30 Spirit)
steps.r: +30 Spirit (Gemrot Skull, Ignagduk)

steps.t: Servi: Ghastly Spear → charm (and venom if not done); Alva at the bottom → The Drowned City
2nd Ascendancy: Trial of Chaos with the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum
steps.r: 2nd Ascendancy: 2 Ascendancy Points

steps.t: Grab the WP at the start, run through to the Apex of Filth
Kill the Queen of Filth → Temple Door Idol; return and talk to Alva (opens Temple of Kopec)
Mushrooms / Cauldron Keeper (quality flasks only)
steps.h: Side content most routes skip: small rewards.

steps.t: Kill Mektul, the Forgemaster → Hammer of Kamasa to Oswald: Reforging Bench
Run to the top, kill Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun; talk to Alva
Go through the Gateway, down the stairs to Utzaal
Kill Viper Napuatzi; kill every Vaal Goliath for the Sacrificial Heart
Sacrifice the Sacrificial Heart at the blood altar (+2 passive points), enter The Black Chambers
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Sacrificial Heart

steps.t: Kill Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge (act boss)
Talk to Doryani (Cataclysm), then Doryani → Hooded One → Alva last → Kingsmarch
Talk to Doryani and Alva, then Makoru at the ship → Isle of Kin
Vendors: Arastas (jewellery/caster), Ngakanu (attack weapons)
Go through to the Volcanic Warrens
Beast Pen (checkpoint): Mimok the Enslaved → Uncut Support Gem Lv4
Blind Beast (Primal Arena) → Greater Blank Rune (trade at Dannig for a Greater Rune)
Fossilised Formation along the outer walls: Lesser Jeweller's Orb
Kill Krutog, Lord of Kin → weapon piece 1/3 (or free Matiki)
Nest (checkpoint): kill the Magma Golems. The one killed last decides the ring: fire → Ruby, lightning → Topaz
Sail to Kedge Bay, run through the fog to Journey's End
Abandoned Ship, Tidal Cay (Tombgrowl), Doran the Deft (rogue exile)
Tujen → kill Captain Hartlin → Verisium → Dannig's Verisium Spikes → free Freya → kill Omniphobia; Tujen: +2 passive points
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Mist-shrouded Tome (Tujen, Dark Mists)

steps.t: Go through to Solitary Confinement; optional Goddess of Justice (flask recovery)
steps.r: Goddess of Justice: +30% life OR mana flask recovery (swappable)

steps.t: Kill The Prisoner → weapon piece 2/3 (or free Matiki)
Kill Scourge of the Skies → weapon piece 3/3 (or free Matiki)
Kill the Great White One → Shark Fin (for Kaimana's permanent buff)
Crabshell Cavern (checkpoint): Uncut Support Gem
Kill Diamora, Song of Death → free Matiki (or weapon piece)
Beckoning Clam (checkpoint) → Humming Pearl → Rog in Kingsmarch: Pearlescent Amulet (all resistances)
Talk to Matiki, peer into the Well, complete the 3 Tests of Mettle, Pay Respects at the Silent Hall (+5% max mana)
steps.r: +5% Maximum Mana (Silent Hall)

steps.t: Complete 3 tests → 3 tattoos (+5% res or +5 attribute each, permanent); kill Yama the White
steps.r: 3 Tattoos (PERMANENT): each +5% fire/cold/lightning res OR +5 Str/Int/Dex

steps.t: Talk to Navali → Tattoo of Hinekora (+2 passive points)
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Tattoo of Hinekora (Navali)

steps.t: Talk to the Hooded One, then Makoru → Arastas (needs all 3 weapon pieces)
Ange → Shoreline Hideout (hideout + trading)
The Runeseeker: turn in 4 Torn Map pieces → Plunder's Point → Expedition → Deserted Post → Farrow (unlocks Verisium Anvil)
Follow Missionary Lorandis, destroy the forcefield, kill Torvian → The Excavation
Bells: cliff side = 3 Exalted Orbs, opposite = 3 Regal Orbs
Kill Benedictus (Precursor Forge), talk to the Hooded One, portal to Kingsmarch
Talk to the Hooded One, then Rhodri at the ship → Ngakanu
Kill Tavakai (final Act 4 boss), talk to him, portal to Kingsmarch
Mad Butcher (Ngakanu hut), Meeting House chests
Talk to the Hooded One → Interludes unlocked; Kaimana: Shark Fin → permanent Lesson
steps.r: Kaimana's Lesson (PERMANENT, needs Shark Fin): Kaom's or Rakiata's

steps.t: Kill Isolde & Heldra → Stones of Serle
Uncut Skill Gem on a corpse by the road (checkpoint)
Activate the 6 megaliths, kill Siora, talk to Una
Checkpoint to the darkness, through The Blackwood to Holten
Omen altars in the Blackwood (Omens / Dark Omens)
steps.h: Side content most routes skip: small rewards.

steps.t: Optional: buy Greater Runes from the Soul of the Ferryman (~2000 gold each)
Sigbert & Godwin (Psalm of Blood) unless doing the Ritual cluster
steps.h: Side content most routes skip: small rewards.

steps.t: Kill Oswin, the Dread Warden → Warden's Ledger (+2 passive points); checkpoint back to Holten
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Warden's Ledger (Oswin)

steps.t: Kill Thane Wulfric & Lady Elswyth; portal out
Talk to Renly, WP to Kingsmarch, Hooded One → Interlude 2 (Vastiri)
Talk to Asala and Zarka, take the NE exit
Take Molten One's Gift (+5% max life)
steps.r: +5% Maximum Life (Molten One's Gift)

steps.t: Just grab the waypoint, go back to the Khari Crossing
Kill Akthi & Anundr (scorpion + sandworm), portal to the Bazaar → Risu: +2 passive points
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Risu, Clearing the Way)

steps.t: Torbik (vendor in a wagon with a checkpoint, NE): kill his attackers first. Sells caster weapons, sceptres, jewellery
Activate the waypoint and carry on through the desert
Kill Elzarah, the Cobra Lord, talk to Asala
Put Yoon's and Rangeen's Barya (found on the way) into the two pedestals at the edges → 2 wishes: rare ring, amulet or jewel
Kill Vornas → Qimah
Pick a Boon at the Seven Pillars; summon Jado (opens Qimah Reservoir)
steps.r: Qimah Boon (swappable): e.g. Tabana +5% all ele res / Orbala 3% MS

steps.t: Kill Azmadi, the Faridun Prince, use the Grand Barya, talk to Jado; portal to the Bazaar → Hooded One → Interlude 3 (Mount Kriar)
2 Vials of Sacred Water (monster drops) into the Sacred Wells → 1 random currency each. Also a rare: Bloodbilge (giant vase)
Through the Ashen Forest to Kriar Village
Ancient Monument (checkpoint): Lv14 Uncut Skill Gem (level scales with interlude order)
Kill Lythara, the Wayward Spear → Gemcrust Skull (+40 Spirit)
steps.r: +40 Spirit (Gemcrust Skull, Lythara)

steps.t: Kill the Abominable Yeti → Icy Tusks; portal to The Glade, give to Hilda: +2 passive points; WP back
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Hilda, Icy Tusks)

steps.t: Kill Rakkar, the Frozen Talon → entrance to Kriar Peaks
Talk to Elder Madox → 1 Unique of your choice; take the platform down into the Etched Ravine
Kill Stormgore, the Guardian → The Cuachic Vault
Kill Zolin & Zelina, then summon and talk to Doryani; WP to Kingsmarch
Sealed Vaults at Stone Altars using Small Soul Cores (currency)
Hooded One: Book of Specialisation (+2 passive points) → Travel to Oriath
steps.r: +2 Passive Points: Book of Specialisation (Hooded One, Siege of Oriath)

steps.t: Talk to the Hooded One and Doryani, use the Map Device. Campaign complete.

endgame.title: Before maps
items: Maps unlock after the last interlude, usually around level 60–65.
Cap your resistances (75%) before mapping seriously.
Ascendancy points 5–8: the Trial of the Sekhemas with a level 60+ Barya (points 5–6) and a level 75+ Barya (points 7–8), or the Trial of Chaos with higher-level Ultimatums.

endgame.title: First steps on the Atlas
items: Clear your first map, then talk to Doryani and Farrow.
Clear your first Precursor Tower to raise the Fortress: Fortress maps give Atlas points.
Do each league mechanic's questline: they give Atlas points too.
Gear up around tier 11 before pushing to tier 15.

endgame.title: League start economy
items: Keep the low-level Uncut Skill and Spirit gems from the campaign: they sell once the Currency Exchange opens in Act 4.
